This '''repair yard''', located at [[Kal'Shebbol starport]], was run by [[Brophar Tofarain]]. During the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol]], a misguided [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] destroyed the facility. Luckily, no one was in the repair yard at the time, as the staff were taking cover in a nearby tavern.
